description: Find video-game companies in IGDB by name — developers, publishers, studios — with country, founding date, description, logo, and how many games each developed and published, with a sample of titles. Answers "who made this" and "what else has this studio shipped". Example: igdb_companies({ query: "Nintendo" }).

_apiKey.description: Twitch app credentials as "CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET" (IGDB is gated by Twitch OAuth). Optional — omit to use the shared Pipeworx credential. Get your own at https://dev.twitch.tv/console.

query.description: Company name or part of one, e.g. "Nintendo", "FromSoftware".

name: igdb_companies
title: Igdb Companies
